Hi weekend crew,

The lead dispatcher reviewed a concern about gate queues just now, and I wanted to pass it on. We need to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and proactive, because people traveling with pets are already juggling a lot. Please keep updates short, clear, and kind, and make sure every traveler gets the same guidance before departure. <<FACT F071>> If a case starts to slow down at the counter, loop in the senior coordinator right away so we can keep the line moving and avoid extra stress for the customer.

Also, please watch for baggage-area confusion and handle it with calm, direct language. <<FACT F063>> If a traveler asks about an unusual animal type, answer cleanly and do not leave them guessing. <<FACT F060>> Thanks for staying sharp and backing each other up so every pet trip feels organized and safe.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
